title: Warm Honey Cardamom Gulab Jamun
hookLine: Golden milk-solid dumplings steeped in fragrant rosewater-cardamom syrup (amazing with vanilla ice cream).

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {mpow_gj} and {ghee_gj} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Roll Crack-Free Milk Spheres
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix {mpow_gj} and {ghee_gj} into a soft dough. Rest 5 mins, then roll into smooth crack-free marbles. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {mpow_gj} and {ghee_gj} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Fry Golden & Steep in Warm Syrup
steps.instructionTemplate: Fry gently over low heat until deep golden brown, then transfer straight into warm {syrup_gj} for 20 minutes to plump up. Let Warm Honey Cardamom Gulab Jamun cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 8 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Frying slowly on low heat cooks the center evenly without burning the outside.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Warm Honey Cardamom Gulab Jamun to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 27 mins.
